properties.statement: `link_artifact` ACCEPTS A REQUIREMENT AS ITS `target_type` AND WRITES A REALIZES EDGE ONTO IT, WHICH THE SCHEMA DOES NOT MODEL. Reported by Alex's Grok 4.6 session, 2026-08-14 (docs/feedback/2026-08-14-alex-grok-session.md, item 11), which could not tell whether the tool was deliberately wider than the skill text or accepting by accident. MEASURED HERE, 2026-08-15, and it is the accident: `describe_schema {from: Artifact, to: Requirement}` returns `exact_matches: 0` and its own note says 'No edge type names both Artifact and Requirement'. REALIZES is declared `Artifact -> *` and its hint reads 'An Artifact implements/realizes a Capability or Component' — so the edge validates through a WILDCARD on the target while the hint names the two types that were meant. `crates/reflow2-mcp/src/tools/built.rs:342` passes `target_type` from the request straight into `LinkArtifactOptions` with no check, and the tool's own description says 'the Capability/Component it implements'. THE SHARP VERSION, and the reason this is worth more than a validation patch: `describe_schema` ALREADY RANKS EXACT MATCHES ABOVE WILDCARD ONES and exists to answer exactly this question — and the served instructions warn agents about this precise trap in the capture step ('several will validate, and validating is not the same as meaning what you intended'). The warning is aimed at agents hand-writing `create_edge`. The TYPED CONVENIENCE TOOL, whose whole promise is that you do not have to reason about the edge, never applies the check it tells its callers to apply. A tool that spares you a decision inherits the duty to get it right. WHY IT MATTERS BEYOND TIDINESS: an Artifact REALIZES a Requirement puts as-built directly onto intent, bypassing the Capability that is supposed to carry delivery — so the golden thread records delivery as ASSERTED at the file, which is what `req:completion-computed` exists to forbid ('computed from the golden thread, never asserted'). NOT ESTABLISHED: whether any detector currently reads such an edge and mis-counts it, or how many exist in the wild — Alex's session made one and it succeeded silently, which is the only instance measured. FIX SHAPE: `link_artifact` refuses a `target_type` that is not Capability or Component, naming the two that are legal, in the same style as the `add_change_event` refusal his session praised for naming the legal values.
